# Overview {-}

**Question.** Do voluntary exercise or mTOR inhibition (rapamycin) change how proteins partition between the insoluble and soluble fractions in old mice, does the effect differ between sexes, and does either intervention oppose the age-associated shifts in partitioning seen in the Adult-versus-Old analysis?

**Design.** Old Control, Old + Exercise and Old + Rapamycin mice of both sexes (Treatment × Sex, 3 × 2). Only samples present in **both** fraction tables are used.

**Volume correction.** Cross-fraction quantities are calculated from whole-fraction-equivalent abundances rather than from LC-input intensities. The soluble fraction had a final volume of 150 µL and the insoluble fraction 100 µL. A 5 µL LC aliquot taken after 1:1 loading-buffer dilution represents 2.5 µL of the original fraction, so:

- soluble whole-fraction scale factor = 150 / 2.5 = **60**; `Soluble_corrected = Soluble_LC × 60`
- insoluble whole-fraction scale factor = 100 / 2.5 = **40**; `Insoluble_corrected = Insoluble_LC × 40`

All cross-fraction quantities (`log2(Insoluble/Soluble)` and the descriptive Soluble/Total plot) use the corrected values. Because the same factors apply to every sample, every valid `log2(Insoluble/Soluble)` is shifted by the constant `log2(40/60) = −0.584963`. Absolute ratios therefore change, but treatment, sex and interaction log2FCs, *P* values and FDR values are mathematically unchanged. The Soluble/Total visualization does change, because it is built from the corrected abundances.

**Statistical approach (in brief).**

| Step | What is done |
|---|---|
| Response | `log2(Insoluble_corrected / Soluble_corrected)` per protein and sample, calculated **only when both fractions are detected for that protein in that sample**; intensities ≤ 0 are missing; no pseudocount, no imputation |
| Filter | ≥ 2 valid paired ratios **in each treatment group** (Control, Exercise, Rapamycin), matching the Adult-vs-Old solubility workflow |
| Model | limma 3 × 2 cell-means model on the six Treatment × Sex groups; `eBayes(trend = TRUE)`; treatment contrasts average Female and Male cell means equally |
| Multiple testing | Benjamini–Hochberg across all retained proteins, separately for each contrast |
| Significance | Raw *P* ≤ 0.05 and FDR ≤ 0.05 are reported separately; **no log2FC threshold** (the ±0.5 lines on the volcano plots are visual references only) |
| Direction | Positive values = relatively more insoluble; negative values = relatively more soluble |

**Descriptive solubility visualization.** Soluble abundance is plotted against total abundance (soluble + insoluble) for the proteins retained in the ratio analysis, using only samples in which both fractions were detected. Old Control, Old + Exercise and Old + Rapamycin are shown in separate panels and proteins are coloured by GO Cellular Component bin. The diagonal is 100% solubility (`Soluble = Total`).

**Directional reversal of aging.** The Adult-vs-Old age effect on `log2(Insoluble/Soluble)` is joined to the Old-treatment effects, using sex-averaged effects and sex-matched Female and Male effects. For each protein the x-axis is the age effect (Old Control − Adult Control) and the y-axis is the treatment effect (Treatment − Old Control). The dotted `y = −x` line marks complete estimated offset of the age effect. A positive age effect is a shift toward relative insolubility, so a negative treatment effect is a shift back toward relative solubility. This is a directional, effect-level analysis rather than a formal test of rescue; FDR-based classification is primary and raw-*P* classification exploratory.

> **Input needed for the reversal analysis.** Create an `AgeResults/` folder next to this file and copy into it the Adult-vs-Old ratio result tables from `3.Solubility_AdOld_v2.Rmd`: `DE_Ratio_Age_Old_vs_Adult.csv` and `Female_vs_Male_AgeEffects_Ratio_limma.csv` (the older `_VC` versions of these names are also accepted and take priority if present). The search is recursive and each name must occur only once. Set `run_reversal_analysis <- FALSE` in *Settings* to skip this section.

**Outputs** (written under `Ratio_OldTrt_VC/`; figures as 600-dpi PNG + editable SVG with separate legends): tables in `Tbl/`, `Ratio/` and `VolumeCorrection/`; figures in `SolTotal/`, `Vol/`, `HM/`, `GO/`, `Int/`, `Reversal/` and `NM_SexFx/`. `Figure_Export_Manifest.csv` lists every exported panel.

> **To run:** keep the two input CSV files (see *Settings*), the `AgeResults/` folder and the `R/` folder next to this file, then knit. Code is folded by default; use the **Code** buttons to expand it.

# Setup

## Packages

All packages must be installed beforehand (the script stops and lists any that are missing). Package load order is kept identical to the original analysis because it determines which functions mask which.

```{r packages}
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "limma", "ComplexHeatmap", "circlize", "ggrepel", "patchwork",
          "cowplot", "clusterProfiler", "org.Mm.eg.db", "GO.db", "AnnotationDbi",
          "viridisLite", "ragg", "svglite")
missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Install missing packages first: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
invisible(lapply(pkgs[1:13], library, character.only = TRUE))
select <- dplyr::select   # AnnotationDbi masks dplyr::select
```

## Settings

```{r settings}
data_dir   <- "."     # folder holding the input files
helper_dir <- "R"     # folder holding nm_export_engine_OT.R
ins_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "Insoluble_Old_One-way.csv")
meta_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Aggregates_SampleList_Mesquita.csv")

sol_file_candidates <- file.path(data_dir, c(
  "Soluble_Old_One-way.csv",
  "Aggregates_Soluble_Old_One-way.csv",
  "Soluble_Old_OneWay.csv"
))

sol_file <- sol_file_candidates[file.exists(sol_file_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(sol_file)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find the soluble old-treatment file.\n",
    "Rename it to one of the following names or edit sol_file_candidates:\n",
    paste(sol_file_candidates, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

analysis_name <- "Insoluble/Soluble ratio — volume corrected"
out_dir <- "Ratio_OldTrt_VC"

# Match the Adult-vs-Old ratio workflow:
# retain proteins with at least this many VALID PAIRED Insoluble/Soluble
# ratios in EACH treatment group.
min_n_ratio <- 2

# ── Whole-fraction volume correction ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Same correction used in the Adult-vs-Old solubility workflow.
sol_fraction_volume_ul <- 150
ins_fraction_volume_ul <- 100

loading_buffer_dilution <- 2
lc_volume_ul <- 5

# 5 uL after 1:1 loading-buffer dilution represents 2.5 uL
# of the original fraction.
original_fraction_ul_in_lc <-
  lc_volume_ul /
  loading_buffer_dilution

sol_scale_factor <-
  sol_fraction_volume_ul /
  original_fraction_ul_in_lc

ins_scale_factor <-
  ins_fraction_volume_ul /
  original_fraction_ul_in_lc

log2_volume_offset <-
  log2(ins_scale_factor / sol_scale_factor)

cat("Soluble whole-fraction scale factor: ", sol_scale_factor, "\n", sep = "")

cat("Insoluble whole-fraction scale factor: ", ins_scale_factor, "\n", sep = "")

cat("Expected log2(Ins/Sol) correction: ", round(log2_volume_offset, 6), "\n", sep = "")

raw_p_cutoff    <- 0.05
fdr_cutoff      <- 0.05
volcano_lfc_ref <- 0.50
z_clip          <- 2.5

# GO settings
run_go_analysis <- TRUE
go_min_genes_per_direction <- 3
go_top_n <- 5

# Interaction plots
# FALSE = raw p <= 0.05 OR FDR <= 0.05
# TRUE  = FDR <= 0.05 only
interaction_fdr_only <- FALSE
interaction_lfc_cutoff <- 0

# ── Adult-vs-Old ratio results used for reversal ──────────────────────────────
# Create an AgeResults/ folder in the Old Treatments project and copy:
#   - the final overall Adult-vs-Old ratio result CSV
#   - Female_vs_Male_AgeEffects_Ratio_limma.csv
ratio_age_results_root <- file.path(data_dir, "AgeResults")

run_reversal_analysis <- TRUE
reversal_max_labels <- 12
reversal_summary_max_names <- 30

# Optional sample exclusions
exclude_samples <- character(0)
```

## Figure export settings (presentation only)

Panel sizes (mm), font sizes (pt) and line/point sizes used for the exported PNG/SVG files. Editing them changes only how figures are drawn and saved, never the data or statistics. Use the exact panel names in `nm_panel_dims` as arguments to `reexport()`, e.g. `reexport("Volcano_Exercise_vs_Control")`; `list_panels()` shows which panels exist once a figure chunk has run. Family names (`family_*` in `nm_dims`) are size defaults derived from these entries, not figure IDs. Heatmaps with automatic height are sized from their protein-row count. Changing a geom setting hard-coded in a plotting chunk requires re-running that chunk, but not refitting limma.

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# INTERNAL FALLBACKS ONLY — not a second figure-dimension settings section.
# Figure-size edits belong exclusively in nm_panel_dims near the top of this Rmd.
# Legacy save calls and dynamically named plots still use a size-family key,
# so derive family defaults from the corresponding exact-ID entries.
# When an ID is absent in this dataset, use the indicated sensible fallback.
nm_family_default <- function(panel_id, width_mm, height_mm) {
  dd <- nm_panel_dims[[panel_id]]
  if (is.null(dd)) c(width = width_mm, height = height_mm) else dd
}
nm_dims <- list(

safe_dir_create <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) {
    dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
}

safe_filename <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001", TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

row_zscore <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  s <- stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (is.na(s) || s == 0) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }

  (x - m) / s
}

first_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\|", ";")
  x <- str_split_fixed(x, ";|,|\\s+", 2)[, 1]

  str_trim(x)
}

find_result_file <- function(root, candidate_names) {

  if (!dir.exists(root)) {
    stop(
      "Could not find folder: ",
      root,
      "\nCreate AgeResults/ in the Old Treatments project and copy the required Adult-vs-Old ratio result CSV files into it."
    )
  }

  files <- list.files(root, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

  for (nm in candidate_names) {
    hit <- files[basename(files) == nm]

    if (length(hit) == 1) {
      return(hit)
    }

    if (length(hit) > 1) {
      stop("More than one file named '", nm, "' was found under ", root, ".")
    }
  }

  stop(
    "Could not find an expected result table under: ",
    root,
    "\nExpected one of:\n",
    paste(candidate_names, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
```

# Load and match soluble/insoluble data

Only Old Control, Old+Exercise, and Old+Rapamycin samples present in **both** fraction tables are used. Proteins are matched by `Protein.Group`, and soluble and insoluble measurements are aligned by sample ID.

```{r construct-ratios}
for (f in c(ins_file, sol_file, meta_file)) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    stop("Could not find input file: ", f)
  }
}

ins <- read.csv(ins_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

sol <- read.csv(sol_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

meta <- read.csv(meta_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_data_cols <- c("Protein.Group", "Genes")

missing_ins <- setdiff(required_data_cols, colnames(ins))

missing_sol <- setdiff(required_data_cols, colnames(sol))

if (length(missing_ins) > 0) {
  stop("Missing insoluble columns: ", paste(missing_ins, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(missing_sol) > 0) {
  stop("Missing soluble columns: ", paste(missing_sol, collapse = ", "))
}

required_meta_cols <- c("ID", "Age", "Treatment", "Sex")

missing_meta <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, colnames(meta))

if (length(missing_meta) > 0) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_meta, collapse = ", "))
}

meta_old <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    Age = str_to_title(str_trim(as.character(Age))),
    Treatment = str_to_title(str_trim(as.character(Treatment))),
    Sex = str_to_title(str_trim(as.character(Sex)))
  ) %>%
  filter(Age == "Old", Treatment %in% c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin"), !ID %in% exclude_samples)

samples_both <- intersect(colnames(ins), colnames(sol))

meta_old <- meta_old %>%
  filter(ID %in% samples_both) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Group = factor(
      paste(Treatment, Sex, sep = "_"),
      levels = c(
        "Control_Female",
        "Control_Male",
        "Exercise_Female",
        "Exercise_Male",
        "Rapamycin_Female",
        "Rapamycin_Male"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Treatment, Sex, ID)

if (nrow(meta_old) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No Old Control/Exercise/Rapamycin samples were ", "shared by the insoluble and soluble files."))
}

cat("\nSample counts per treatment × sex:\n")

print(table(meta_old$Treatment, meta_old$Sex))

if (any(table(meta_old$Group) == 0)) {
  warning(
    paste0("At least one Treatment × Sex cell contains no samples. ", "The factorial model may not be estimable.")
  )
}

sample_ids <- meta_old$ID

treatment_ids <- split(meta_old$ID, meta_old$Treatment)

common_pg <- intersect(ins$Protein.Group, sol$Protein.Group)

if (length(common_pg) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No overlapping Protein.Group entries were found ", "between soluble and insoluble fractions."))
}

# Protein.Group should uniquely identify rows for one-to-one fraction matching.
if (anyDuplicated(ins$Protein.Group[ins$Protein.Group %in% common_pg]) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate Protein.Group entries were found in the insoluble table.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(sol$Protein.Group[sol$Protein.Group %in% common_pg]) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate Protein.Group entries were found in the soluble table.")
}

common_pg_sorted <- sort(common_pg)

ins_sub <- ins %>%
  filter(Protein.Group %in% common_pg) %>%
  select(Protein.Group, Genes, all_of(sample_ids)) %>%
  arrange(match(Protein.Group, common_pg_sorted))

sol_sub <- sol %>%
  filter(Protein.Group %in% common_pg) %>%
  select(Protein.Group, Genes, all_of(sample_ids)) %>%
  arrange(match(Protein.Group, common_pg_sorted))

stopifnot(identical(ins_sub$Protein.Group, sol_sub$Protein.Group))

gene_display <- ifelse(
  !is.na(sol_sub$Genes) &
    sol_sub$Genes != "",
  sol_sub$Genes,
  ifelse(!is.na(ins_sub$Genes) & ins_sub$Genes != "", ins_sub$Genes, sol_sub$Protein.Group)
)

gene_clean <- first_gene_symbol(gene_display)

gene_clean <- ifelse(is.na(gene_clean) | gene_clean == "", as.character(sol_sub$Protein.Group), gene_clean)

row_id <- make.unique(gene_clean)

row_key_all <- tibble(
  row_id = row_id,
  Protein.Group = sol_sub$Protein.Group,
  Genes = gene_display,
  Gene_clean = gene_clean
)

mat_ins <- ins_sub %>%
  select(all_of(sample_ids)) %>%
  as.matrix()

mat_sol <- sol_sub %>%
  select(all_of(sample_ids)) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(mat_ins) <- "numeric"
storage.mode(mat_sol) <- "numeric"

rownames(mat_ins) <- row_id
rownames(mat_sol) <- row_id

# Non-detections are missing values.
# No pseudocount is added.
mat_ins[!is.finite(mat_ins) | mat_ins <= 0] <- NA

mat_sol[!is.finite(mat_sol) | mat_sol <= 0] <- NA

# Apply the fraction-volume correction before any cross-fraction ratio
# or Soluble/Total calculation.
mat_sol_corrected <- mat_sol * sol_scale_factor
mat_ins_corrected <- mat_ins * ins_scale_factor

volume_correction_parameters <- tibble(
  Parameter = c(
    "Soluble fraction volume (uL)",
    "Insoluble fraction volume (uL)",
    "LC aliquot volume (uL)",
    "Loading-buffer dilution",
    "Original fraction represented in LC aliquot (uL)",
    "Soluble scale factor",
    "Insoluble scale factor",
    "Expected log2(Ins/Sol) offset"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sol_fraction_volume_ul,
    ins_fraction_volume_ul,
    lc_volume_ul,
    loading_buffer_dilution,
    original_fraction_ul_in_lc,
    sol_scale_factor,
    ins_scale_factor,
    log2_volume_offset
  )
)

write.csv(volume_correction_parameters, file.path(qc_dir, "VolumeCorrection_parameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

volume_correction_parameters
```

# Build and filter matched insoluble-to-soluble ratios

A valid ratio requires both fractions to be detected for that protein in that sample. The same `min_n_ratio = 2` criterion used in the Adult-vs-Old workflow is applied to **each** treatment group.

```{r ratio-tables}
# Uncorrected ratio retained only for volume-correction QC.
ratio_mat_all_uncorrected <- log2(mat_ins) - log2(mat_sol)

# Primary response used for every downstream analysis.
ratio_mat_all <- log2(mat_ins_corrected) - log2(mat_sol_corrected)

ratio_volume_shift <-
  ratio_mat_all -
  ratio_mat_all_uncorrected

observed_mean_shift <- mean(ratio_volume_shift, na.rm = TRUE)

max_shift_error <- max(abs(ratio_volume_shift - log2_volume_offset), na.rm = TRUE)

volume_correction_qc <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Expected log2(Ins/Sol) offset",
    "Observed mean log2(Ins/Sol) offset",
    "Maximum absolute deviation from expected offset"
  ),
  Value = c(log2_volume_offset, observed_mean_shift, max_shift_error)
)

write.csv(volume_correction_qc, file.path(qc_dir, "VolumeCorrection_ratio_QC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (!is.finite(max_shift_error) || max_shift_error > 1e-10) {
  stop("Volume-correction QC failed: corrected-current ratio shift is not the expected constant.")
}

cat("Observed mean log2(Ins/Sol) shift: ", round(observed_mean_shift, 6), "\n", sep = "")

cat(sprintf("\nProteins before paired-ratio filter: %d\n", nrow(ratio_mat_all)))

valid_counts <- tibble(row_id = rownames(ratio_mat_all))

for (trt in levels(meta_old$Treatment)) {

  ids <- treatment_ids[[trt]]

  valid_counts[[paste0("n_valid_", trt)]] <- rowSums(!is.na(ratio_mat_all[, ids, drop = FALSE]))
}

keep_ratio <- rep(TRUE, nrow(ratio_mat_all))

for (trt in levels(meta_old$Treatment)) {

  keep_ratio <- keep_ratio &
    valid_counts[[paste0("n_valid_", trt)]] >= min_n_ratio
}

ratio_mat <- ratio_mat_all[keep_ratio, , drop = FALSE]

row_key <- row_key_all %>%
  filter(row_id %in% rownames(ratio_mat))

valid_counts <- valid_counts %>%
  filter(row_id %in% rownames(ratio_mat)) %>%
  left_join(row_key, by = "row_id")

cat(
  sprintf(
    paste0("Proteins after requiring ≥%d valid paired ratios ", "in Control, Exercise, and Rapamycin: %d\n"),
    min_n_ratio,
    nrow(ratio_mat)
  )
)

if (nrow(ratio_mat) == 0) {
  stop("No proteins passed the paired Insoluble/Soluble ratio filter.")
}

write.csv(row_key, file.path(ratio_table_dir, "Ratio_row_key.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(valid_counts, file.path(ratio_table_dir, "Ratio_valid_counts_by_treatment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Long-form paired measurements for export and plotting.
ins_long <- mat_ins_corrected[rownames(ratio_mat), sample_ids, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("row_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -row_id, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Insoluble")

sol_long <- mat_sol_corrected[rownames(ratio_mat), sample_ids, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("row_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -row_id, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Soluble")

ratio_long <- ratio_mat[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("row_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -row_id, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "log2_ratio") %>%
  left_join(ins_long, by = c("row_id", "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(sol_long, by = c("row_id", "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(meta_old %>% select(ID, Treatment, Sex, Group), by = c("Sample" = "ID")) %>%
  left_join(row_key, by = "row_id")

ratio_export <- ratio_long %>%
  select(row_id, Protein.Group, Genes, Gene_clean, Sample, Treatment, Sex, Insoluble, Soluble, log2_ratio)

write.csv(ratio_export, file.path(ratio_table_dir, "Ratio_perSample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

ratio_summary <- ratio_long %>%
  group_by(row_id, Protein.Group, Genes, Gene_clean, Treatment, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(log2_ratio)),
    mean_log2_ratio = if_else(n_valid > 0, mean(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    sd_log2_ratio = if_else(n_valid > 1, sd(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    sem_log2_ratio = if_else(n_valid > 1, sd_log2_ratio / sqrt(n_valid), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(ratio_summary, file.path(ratio_table_dir, "Ratio_summaryByTreatSex.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

meta_use <- meta_old %>%
  filter(ID %in% colnames(ratio_mat)) %>%
  arrange(Treatment, Sex, ID)

ratio_mat <- ratio_mat[, meta_use$ID, drop = FALSE]
```

## Volume-correction QC

The correction is verified before fitting any statistical model. Every valid ratio must shift by `r round(log2_volume_offset, 6)` relative to the uncorrected LC-input ratio.

```{r show-volume-correction-qc}
volume_correction_qc
```

Because the shift is constant across all samples, differential contrasts on `log2(Insoluble/Soluble)` are invariant to the correction. The corrected values are nevertheless used throughout so the absolute partitioning scale and the Soluble/Total visualization correspond to whole-fraction-equivalent abundance.

# Individual protein solubility

This descriptive visualization uses the **same proteins retained for the paired Insoluble/Soluble ratio analysis**. For each treatment, soluble abundance and total abundance are summarized from samples with paired soluble and insoluble measurements. Sexes are combined descriptively within each treatment panel.

## GO Cellular Component bins

Proteins are assigned to a single GO Cellular Component bin using the same fixed priority order used in the Adult-vs-Old solubility workflow. Each bin contains the specified GO term and its GO-CC offspring.

```{r go-cc-bins}
bin_roots <- list(
  "ECM"                 = c("GO:0031012"),
  "Extracellular"       = c("GO:0005576"),
  "Sarcomere/Myofibril" = c("GO:0030017", "GO:0030016", "GO:0043292"),
  "Cytoskeleton"        = c("GO:0005856"),
  "Mitochondrion"       = c("GO:0005739"),
  "Nucleus"             = c("GO:0005634"),
  "Ribosome"            = c("GO:0005840"),
  "ER"                  = c("GO:0005783"),
  "Golgi"               = c("GO:0005794"),
  "Plasma membrane"     = c("GO:0005886"),
  "Endosome/Lysosome"   = c("GO:0005768", "GO:0005764"),
  "Proteasome"          = c("GO:0000502"),
  "Cytosol"             = c("GO:0005829")
)

bin_priority <- names(bin_roots)

go_cc_offspring <- AnnotationDbi::as.list(GO.db::GOCCOFFSPRING)

get_offspring <- function(go_id) {
  kids <- go_cc_offspring[[go_id]]

  unique(c(go_id, kids))
}

bin_terms <- lapply(
  bin_roots,
  function(ids) {
    unique(unlist(lapply(ids, get_offspring), use.names = FALSE))
  }
)

assign_bin <- function(go_vec) {

  go_vec <- unique(go_vec[!is.na(go_vec)])

  if (length(go_vec) == 0) {
    return("Other")
  }

  for (b in bin_priority) {
    if (any(go_vec %in% bin_terms[[b]])) {
      return(b)
    }
  }

  "Other"
}

genes_cc <- sort(unique(na.omit(row_key$Gene_clean)))

g2e_cc <- suppressMessages(
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = genes_cc,
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))

e2go_cc <- suppressMessages(
  AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = unique(g2e_cc$ENTREZID),
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    columns = c("ENTREZID", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == "CC", !is.na(GO)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, GO)

gene_bin_cc <- g2e_cc %>%
  dplyr::left_join(e2go_cc, by = "ENTREZID") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(GO_CC = list(unique(GO)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Bin = vapply(GO_CC, assign_bin, character(1)))

write.csv(gene_bin_cc %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, Bin), file.path(soltot_dir, "GO_CC_bins.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Soluble versus total abundance by treatment

The dashed diagonal corresponds to `Soluble = Soluble + Insoluble`, i.e. 100% soluble abundance. Because only paired measurements are used, points cannot exceed this line except for negligible floating-point effects.

```{r solubility-figure, fig.keep="none"}
sol_total_df <- ratio_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Soluble), !is.na(Insoluble), !is.na(log2_ratio)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Total = Soluble + Insoluble) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(row_id, Protein.Group, Gene_clean, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_paired = dplyr::n(),
    mean_soluble = mean(Soluble, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_total = mean(Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log10_total = dplyr::if_else(mean_total > 0, log10(mean_total), NA_real_),
    log10_sol = dplyr::if_else(mean_soluble > 0, log10(mean_soluble), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log10_total), !is.na(log10_sol)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_bin_cc %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, Bin), by = c("Gene_clean" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Bin = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Bin), "Other", Bin),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("Control", "Exercise", "Rapamycin"),
      labels = c("Old Ctl", "Old+Ex", "Old+Rapa")
    )
  )

bins_present_soltot <- sort(unique(sol_total_df$Bin[sol_total_df$Bin != "Other"]))

bin_pal_soltot <- setNames(
  viridisLite::viridis(length(bins_present_soltot), option = "D", end = 0.95),
  bins_present_soltot
)

bin_pal_soltot["Other"] <- "grey75"

bin_levels_soltot <- c(bins_present_soltot, "Other")

sol_total_df <- sol_total_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Bin = factor(Bin, levels = bin_levels_soltot))

lims_soltot <- range(c(sol_total_df$log10_total, sol_total_df$log10_sol), na.rm = TRUE)

lims_soltot <- c(floor(lims_soltot[1]), ceiling(lims_soltot[2]))

p_sol_total <- ggplot(sol_total_df, aes(x = log10_total, y = log10_sol, colour = Bin)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = sol_total_df %>% dplyr::filter(Bin == "Other"), alpha = 0.30, size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(data = sol_total_df %>% dplyr::filter(Bin != "Other"), alpha = 0.75, size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = bin_pal_soltot,
    breaks = bin_levels_soltot,
    drop = TRUE,
    name = "Cellular Component",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5, alpha = 1))
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lims_soltot, ylim = lims_soltot) +
  facet_wrap(~ Treatment, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Protein Solubility in Skeletal Muscle — Volume Corrected",
    subtitle = paste0("Dashed diagonal: 100% solubility; points farther below have lower soluble / total ratio."),
    x = expression(log[10]("Total Abundance (Soluble + Insoluble)")),
    y = expression(log[10]("Soluble Abundance")),
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

soltot_png <- file.path(soltot_dir, "Solubility_OldTreatments.png")

save_plot_png(p_sol_total, soltot_png, width = 14, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)

write.csv(sol_total_df, file.path(soltot_dir, "Solubility_OldTreatments_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Treatment × Sex limma model

```{r limma-model}
group_vec <- factor(meta_use$Group, levels = levels(meta_use$Group))

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group_vec)
colnames(design) <- levels(group_vec)

fit <- lmFit(ratio_mat[, meta_use$ID, drop = FALSE], design)

cont_mat <- makeContrasts(
  Ex_vs_Ctl =
    ((Exercise_Female + Exercise_Male) / 2) -
    ((Control_Female + Control_Male) / 2),

  Rapa_vs_Ctl =
    ((Rapamycin_Female + Rapamycin_Male) / 2) -
    ((Control_Female + Control_Male) / 2),

  Rapa_vs_Ex =
    ((Rapamycin_Female + Rapamycin_Male) / 2) -
    ((Exercise_Female + Exercise_Male) / 2),

  Sex =
    ((Control_Male + Exercise_Male + Rapamycin_Male) / 3) -
    ((Control_Female + Exercise_Female + Rapamycin_Female) / 3),

  Ex_SexInt =
    (Exercise_Male - Control_Male) -
    (Exercise_Female - Control_Female),

  Rapa_SexInt =
    (Rapamycin_Male - Control_Male) -
    (Rapamycin_Female - Control_Female),

  Ex_vs_Ctl_Female =
    Exercise_Female - Control_Female,

  Ex_vs_Ctl_Male =
    Exercise_Male - Control_Male,

  Rapa_vs_Ctl_Female =
    Rapamycin_Female - Control_Female,

  Rapa_vs_Ctl_Male =
    Rapamycin_Male - Control_Male,

  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont_mat)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2, trend = TRUE)

contrast_meta <- tribble(
  ~coef_name, ~label, ~file_tag, ~x_label,
  "Ex_vs_Ctl",
  "Exercise vs Control",
  "Exercise_vs_Control",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble): Old+Exercise - Old Control",

  "Rapa_vs_Ctl",
  "Rapamycin vs Control",
  "Rapamycin_vs_Control",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble): Old+Rapamycin - Old Control",

  "Rapa_vs_Ex",
  "Rapamycin vs Exercise",
  "Rapamycin_vs_Exercise",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble): Old+Rapamycin - Old+Exercise",

  "Sex",
  "Male vs Female",
  "Sex_Male_vs_Female",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble): Male - Female",

  "Ex_SexInt",
  "Exercise × Sex Interaction",
  "ExerciseSex_Interaction",
  "Interaction effect on log2(Insoluble/Soluble)",

  "Rapa_SexInt",
  "Rapamycin × Sex Interaction",
  "RapamycinSex_Interaction",
  "Interaction effect on log2(Insoluble/Soluble)",

  "Ex_vs_Ctl_Female",
  "Exercise vs Control — Female",
  "Exercise_vs_Control_Female",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble) in females",

  "Ex_vs_Ctl_Male",
  "Exercise vs Control — Male",
  "Exercise_vs_Control_Male",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble) in males",

  "Rapa_vs_Ctl_Female",
  "Rapamycin vs Control — Female",
  "Rapamycin_vs_Control_Female",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble) in females",

  "Rapa_vs_Ctl_Male",
  "Rapamycin vs Control — Male",
  "Rapamycin_vs_Control_Male",
  "Change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble) in males"
)

make_result_table <- function(coef_name, label, x_label) {
  topTable(fit2, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "none") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein") %>%
    left_join(row_key %>% select(Protein = row_id, Protein.Group, Genes, Gene_clean), by = "Protein") %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast = label,
      X_label = x_label,

      SigFDR =
        !is.na(adj.P.Val) &
        adj.P.Val <= fdr_cutoff,

      SigRawOnly =
        !is.na(P.Value) &
        P.Value <= raw_p_cutoff &
        !SigFDR,

      SigAny = SigFDR | SigRawOnly,

      Direction = case_when(SigAny & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher ratio", SigAny & logFC < 0 ~ "Lower ratio", TRUE ~ "NS"),

      SigClass = case_when(SigFDR ~ "FDR <= 0.05", SigRawOnly ~ "Raw p <= 0.05 only", TRUE ~ "NS"),

      Biological_direction = case_when(
        SigAny & logFC > 0 ~ "Shift toward insoluble",
        SigAny & logFC < 0 ~ "Shift toward soluble",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
}

results_list <- pmap(
  contrast_meta,
  function(coef_name, label, file_tag, x_label) {
    make_result_table(coef_name, label, x_label)
  }
)

names(results_list) <- contrast_meta$coef_name

for (i in seq_len(nrow(contrast_meta))) {
  write.csv(
    results_list[[contrast_meta$coef_name[i]]],
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("DE_", contrast_meta$file_tag[i], ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

res_ex_ctl      <- results_list$Ex_vs_Ctl
res_rapa_ctl    <- results_list$Rapa_vs_Ctl
res_rapa_ex     <- results_list$Rapa_vs_Ex
res_sex         <- results_list$Sex
res_ex_int      <- results_list$Ex_SexInt
res_rapa_int    <- results_list$Rapa_SexInt
res_ex_female   <- results_list$Ex_vs_Ctl_Female
res_ex_male     <- results_list$Ex_vs_Ctl_Male
res_rapa_female <- results_list$Rapa_vs_Ctl_Female
res_rapa_male   <- results_list$Rapa_vs_Ctl_Male

# Omnibus Treatment and Treatment×Sex F-tests
max_abs_treatment <- full_join(
  res_ex_ctl %>% select(Protein, logFC_ex = logFC),
  res_rapa_ctl %>% select(Protein, logFC_rapa = logFC),
  by = "Protein"
) %>%
  mutate(max_abs_logFC = pmax(abs(logFC_ex), abs(logFC_rapa), na.rm = TRUE))

max_abs_interaction <- full_join(
  res_ex_int %>% select(Protein, logFC_ex_int = logFC),
  res_rapa_int %>% select(Protein, logFC_rapa_int = logFC),
  by = "Protein"
) %>%
  mutate(max_abs_interaction = pmax(abs(logFC_ex_int), abs(logFC_rapa_int), na.rm = TRUE))

make_omnibus_table <- function(coef_names, label, max_abs_tbl, max_col) {
  topTable(fit2, coef = coef_names, number = Inf, sort.by = "F") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein") %>%
    left_join(row_key %>% select(Protein = row_id, Protein.Group, Genes, Gene_clean), by = "Protein") %>%
    left_join(max_abs_tbl, by = "Protein") %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast = label,

      SigFDR =
        !is.na(adj.P.Val) &
        adj.P.Val <= fdr_cutoff,

      SigRawOnly =
        !is.na(P.Value) &
        P.Value <= raw_p_cutoff &
        !SigFDR,

      SigAny = SigFDR | SigRawOnly,

      SigClass = case_when(SigFDR ~ "FDR <= 0.05", SigRawOnly ~ "Raw p <= 0.05 only", TRUE ~ "NS")
    )
}

res_treatment_main <- make_omnibus_table(
  c("Ex_vs_Ctl", "Rapa_vs_Ctl"),
  "Treatment omnibus",
  max_abs_treatment,
  "max_abs_logFC"
)

res_interaction_main <- make_omnibus_table(
  c("Ex_SexInt", "Rapa_SexInt"),
  "Treatment × Sex omnibus",
  max_abs_interaction,
  "max_abs_interaction"
)

write.csv(res_treatment_main, file.path(table_dir, "DE_Treatment_omnibus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(res_interaction_main, file.path(table_dir, "DE_TreatmentSex_omnibus.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r colours}
col_control <- "#59C761"
col_ex      <- "#F2D925"
col_rapa    <- "#64106E"

col_male    <- "#029E73"

col_higher <- "#D62728"
col_lower  <- "#1F77B4"
col_ns     <- "grey75"

trt_cols <- c("Control" = col_control, "Exercise" = col_ex, "Rapamycin" = col_rapa)

sex_cols <- c("Female" = col_female, "Male" = col_male)
```

# Volcano plots

Positive treatment log2FC values indicate a higher insoluble-to-soluble ratio (shift toward the insoluble fraction), whereas negative values indicate a lower ratio (shift toward the soluble fraction). Open colored circles indicate proteins meeting only the raw-p threshold; solid colored circles indicate proteins passing FDR.

```{r volcano-plots, fig.keep="none"}
make_volcano <- function(res, file_tag, title = unique(res$Contrast)) {
  res_plot <- res %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_p = -log10(P.Value),
      neg_log10_p = ifelse(is.finite(neg_log10_p), neg_log10_p, NA_real_),

      DirectionLegend = case_when(
        SigAny & logFC > 0 ~ "Higher ratio",
        SigAny & logFC < 0 ~ "Lower ratio",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),

      DirectionLegend = factor(DirectionLegend, levels = c("Higher ratio", "Lower ratio", "NS")),

      SigShape = case_when(SigFDR ~ "FDR", SigRawOnly ~ "Raw p-value", TRUE ~ "NS"),

      SigShape = factor(SigShape, levels = c("FDR", "Raw p-value", "NS"))
    )

  label_tbl <- bind_rows(
    res_plot %>%
      filter(SigAny, logFC > 0) %>%
      slice_min(P.Value, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE),

    res_plot %>%
      filter(SigAny, logFC < 0) %>%
      slice_min(P.Value, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE)
  ) %>%
    distinct(Protein, .keep_all = TRUE)

  n_higher <- sum(res_plot$SigAny & res_plot$logFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  n_lower <- sum(res_plot$SigAny & res_plot$logFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  n_ns <- sum(!res_plot$SigAny, na.rm = TRUE)

  direction_colors <- c("Higher ratio" = col_higher, "Lower ratio" = col_lower, "NS" = col_ns)

  direction_labels <- c(
    "Higher ratio" = paste0("Higher ratio (", n_higher, ")"),
    "Lower ratio" = paste0("Lower ratio (", n_lower, ")"),
    "NS" = paste0("NS (", n_ns, ")")
  )

  shape_values <- c("FDR" = 16, "Raw p-value" = 1, "NS" = 16)
p <- ggplot(res_plot, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_p)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = DirectionLegend, shape = SigShape),
      size = 2.3,
      stroke = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.90,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(raw_p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-volcano_lfc_ref, volcano_lfc_ref),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey65",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_tbl,
      aes(label = Protein),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 20,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      segment.alpha = 0.55,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = direction_colors, labels = direction_labels, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = shape_values,
      limits = c("FDR", "Raw p-value", "NS"),
      breaks = c("FDR", "Raw p-value"),
      labels = c(paste0("FDR <= ", fdr_cutoff), paste0("Raw p-value <= ", raw_p_cutoff)),
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3, alpha = 1)),
      shape = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        override.aes = list(shape = c(16, 1), color = "black", size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 1)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Insoluble-to-Soluble Ratio - ", title),
      x = unique(res$X_label),
      y = "-log10(raw p-value)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey45", size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.45, "cm")
    )

  save_plot_png(p, file.path(volcano_dir, paste0("Volcano_", file_tag)), width = 8.2, height = 6.4, dpi = 300)

  p
}

p_v_ex_ctl <- make_volcano(res_ex_ctl, "Exercise_vs_Control")

p_v_rapa_ctl <- make_volcano(res_rapa_ctl, "Rapamycin_vs_Control")

p_v_sex <- make_volcano(res_sex, "Sex_Male_vs_Female")

p_v_ex_int <- make_volcano(res_ex_int, "ExerciseSex_Interaction")

p_v_rapa_int <- make_volcano(res_rapa_int, "RapamycinSex_Interaction")

combined_v <- (p_v_ex_ctl | p_v_rapa_ctl | p_v_sex) / (p_v_ex_int | p_v_rapa_int | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Insoluble-to-Soluble Ratio - Differential Protein Partitioning",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))
  )

save_plot_png(combined_v, file.path(volcano_dir, "Volcano_Combined"), width = 21, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```

# Significant-protein heatmaps

These heatmaps show proteins significant by raw p ≤ 0.05 or FDR ≤ 0.05 for Exercise vs Control, Rapamycin vs Control, and the overall Sex contrast. The Exercise vs Control heatmap includes only Control and Exercise samples; the Rapamycin vs Control heatmap includes only Control and Rapamycin samples. Both sexes are retained within each displayed treatment. The overall Sex heatmap includes all three treatment groups. Each protein is standardized across the samples displayed in that heatmap using a row-wise Z score. Thus, the heatmap emphasizes relative partitioning patterns within a protein rather than comparing absolute ratio magnitude between proteins. Protein selection and the displayed raw-p/FDR values use the existing 3 × 2 limma model results.

Interaction heatmaps are omitted; Treatment × Sex interactions are displayed later as mean ± SEM plots.

```{r heatmaps, fig.keep="none"}
heatmap_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-z_clip, 0, z_clip), c(col_lower, "white", col_higher))

meta_ord <- meta_use %>%
  arrange(Treatment, Sex, ID)

col_order <- meta_ord$ID

top_ann <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Treatment = meta_ord$Treatment,
  Sex = meta_ord$Sex,
  col = list(Treatment = trt_cols, Sex = sex_cols),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$legend_title, fontface = "bold"),
  gap = grid::unit(1, "mm")
)

make_pval_heatmap <- function(info_tbl, row_names, raw_col = "P.Value", fdr_col = "adj.P.Val") {
  pval_text <- cbind(Raw = format_p(info_tbl[[raw_col]]), FDR = format_p(info_tbl[[fdr_col]]))

  pval_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(info_tbl), ncol = 2, dimnames = list(row_names, c("Raw", "FDR")))

  Heatmap(
    pval_mat,
    name = "p-value",
    col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "white")),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
    show_row_names = FALSE,
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_side = "top",
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$axis_text, fontface = "bold"),
    column_title = "p-value",
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$axis_text, fontface = "bold"),
    width = grid::unit(24, "mm"),
    rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "white"),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      this_p <- if (j == 1) {
        info_tbl[[raw_col]][i]
      } else {
        info_tbl[[fdr_col]][i]
      }

      this_cutoff <- if (j == 1) {
        raw_p_cutoff
      } else {
        fdr_cutoff
      }

      grid::grid.text(
        pval_text[i, j],
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fontsize = nm_style$legend_text,
          fontface = ifelse(!is.na(this_p) & this_p <= this_cutoff, "bold", "plain")
        )
      )
    }
  )
}

make_sig_heatmap <- function(res, file_tag, title, row_split_by = "Direction", treatments = NULL) {
  sig_tbl <- res %>%
    filter(SigAny, Protein %in% rownames(ratio_mat)) %>%
    arrange(Direction, P.Value) %>%
    mutate(DisplayLabel = ifelse(!is.na(Gene_clean) & Gene_clean != "", Gene_clean, Protein))

  write.csv(sig_tbl, file.path(heatmap_dir, paste0("Heatmap_input_", file_tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  if (nrow(sig_tbl) < 2) {
    message("Skipping heatmap for ", title, ": fewer than 2 significant proteins.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Subset only this heatmap; shared metadata stay available to all-group plots.
  hm_meta <- meta_ord
  if (!is.null(treatments)) {
    hm_meta <- hm_meta[hm_meta$Treatment %in% treatments, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  hm_meta <- droplevels(hm_meta)

  top_ann_hm <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Treatment = hm_meta$Treatment,
    Sex = hm_meta$Sex,
    col = list(
      Treatment = trt_cols[unique(as.character(hm_meta$Treatment))],
      Sex = sex_cols[unique(as.character(hm_meta$Sex))]
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$legend_title, fontface = "bold"),
    gap = grid::unit(1, "mm")
  )

  # Compute row Z scores using only the samples displayed in this heatmap.
  hm_mat <- ratio_mat[sig_tbl$Protein, hm_meta$ID, drop = FALSE]

  hm_z <- t(apply(hm_mat, 1, row_zscore))

  hm_z[!is.finite(hm_z)] <- 0
  hm_z[hm_z > z_clip] <- z_clip
  hm_z[hm_z < -z_clip] <- -z_clip

  row_labels <- make.unique(sig_tbl$DisplayLabel)

  if (row_split_by == "Direction") {
    row_split <- factor(sig_tbl$Direction, levels = c("Higher ratio", "Lower ratio", "NS"))
  } else {
    row_split <- factor(sig_tbl$SigClass, levels = c("FDR <= 0.05", "Raw p <= 0.05 only", "NS"))
  }

  ht_main <- Heatmap(
    hm_z,
    name = "Z-score",
    col = heatmap_col_fun,
    na_col = "grey85",
    top_annotation = top_ann_hm,

    column_split = hm_meta$Treatment,
    column_gap = grid::unit(3, "mm"),

    row_split = row_split,
    row_gap = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
    row_title_side = "left",
    row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$axis_text, fontface = "bold"),

    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    cluster_column_slices = FALSE,

    show_column_names = FALSE,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_labels = row_labels,
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$legend_text, fontface = "bold"),

    column_title = title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = nm_style$plot_title, fontface = "bold"),

    border = FALSE,

    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Row Z-score",
      title_position = "topcenter",
      at = c(-z_clip, 0, z_clip),
      labels = c(paste0("-", z_clip), "0", as.character(z_clip))
    )
  )

  ht_p <- make_pval_heatmap(sig_tbl, rownames(hm_z))

  ht <- ht_main + ht_p

  hm_h <- max(5.5, nrow(sig_tbl) * 0.26 + 3.2)

  save_heatmap_png(
    ht,
    file.path(heatmap_dir, paste0("Heatmap_", file_tag, "_rawP_FDR")),
    width = 14.2,
    height = hm_h,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ht
}

ht_ex_ctl <- make_sig_heatmap(
  res_ex_ctl,
  "Exercise_vs_Control",
  "Insoluble/Soluble ratio — Exercise vs Control significant proteins",
  treatments = c("Control", "Exercise")
)

ht_rapa_ctl <- make_sig_heatmap(
  res_rapa_ctl,
  "Rapamycin_vs_Control",
  "Insoluble/Soluble ratio — Rapamycin vs Control significant proteins",
  treatments = c("Control", "Rapamycin")
)

ht_sex <- make_sig_heatmap(
  res_sex,
  "Sex_Male_vs_Female",
  "Insoluble/Soluble ratio — Sex-effect significant proteins"
)
```

# GO Biological Process enrichment

For Exercise vs Control and Rapamycin vs Control, GO Biological Process enrichment is performed separately for proteins with higher and lower insoluble-to-soluble ratios. Separate analyses are retained for **FDR-significant proteins** and **raw-p-significant proteins**.

Gene symbols are mapped to Entrez IDs using `org.Mm.eg.db`. The background universe is the set of genes represented by proteins that passed the paired-ratio filter. Enrichment is performed using `clusterProfiler::enrichGO()` for the Biological Process ontology with a hypergeometric over-representation test and Benjamini-Hochberg multiple-testing adjustment. The top five terms per direction are ranked by GO-adjusted p-value. Fold enrichment is calculated as GeneRatio divided by BgRatio.

```{r go-bp, fig.keep="none"}
map_symbols_to_entrez <- function(symbols) {
  symbols <- symbols[!is.na(symbols) & symbols != ""] %>%
    unique()

  if (length(symbols) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  suppressMessages({
    mapped <- tryCatch(
      bitr(symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, drop = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  })

  if (is.null(mapped) || nrow(mapped) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  unique(mapped$ENTREZID)
}

parse_ratio <- function(x) {
  num <- as.numeric(str_replace(x, "/.*$", ""))

  den <- as.numeric(str_replace(x, "^.*/", ""))

  num / den
}

run_go_bp_one_direction <- function(symbols, universe_symbols, direction_label) {
  if (length(unique(symbols)) < go_min_genes_per_direction) {
    message("Skipping GO for ", direction_label, ": fewer than ", go_min_genes_per_direction, " genes.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  eg <- map_symbols_to_entrez(symbols)
  universe_eg <- map_symbols_to_entrez(universe_symbols)

  if (length(eg) < go_min_genes_per_direction) {
    message(
      "Skipping GO for ",
      direction_label,
      ": fewer than ",
      go_min_genes_per_direction,
      " mapped Entrez IDs."
    )
    return(NULL)
  }

  ego <- tryCatch(
    enrichGO(
      gene = eg,
      universe = universe_eg,
      OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
      ont = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.25,
      readable = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(ego) || nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) == 0) {
    message("No enriched GO BP terms for ", direction_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  as.data.frame(ego) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = direction_label,
      GeneRatio_num = parse_ratio(GeneRatio),
      BgRatio_num = parse_ratio(BgRatio),
      FoldEnrich = GeneRatio_num / BgRatio_num,
      neg_log10_fdr = -log10(p.adjust)
    )
}

make_go_lollipop_contrast <- function(res_tbl, sig_filter, analysis_label, file_tag, contrast_title) {
  if (!run_go_analysis) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  sig_filter_quo <- rlang::enquo(sig_filter)

  go_input <- res_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(!!sig_filter_quo) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene_clean), Gene_clean != "", !is.na(logFC), logFC != 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Higher ratio", "Lower ratio"))

  genes_higher <- go_input %>%
    filter(Direction == "Higher ratio") %>%
    pull(Gene_clean) %>%
    unique()

  genes_lower <- go_input %>%
    filter(Direction == "Lower ratio") %>%
    pull(Gene_clean) %>%
    unique()

  universe_genes <- row_key$Gene_clean %>%
    unique()

  cat(
    sprintf(
      "\nGO input [%s, %s]: %d Higher ratio, %d Lower ratio\n",
      contrast_title,
      analysis_label,
      length(genes_higher),
      length(genes_lower)
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    go_input %>%
      select(Protein, Protein.Group, Genes, Gene_clean, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction),
    file.path(go_dir, paste0("GO_INPUT_", file_tag, "_protein_to_gene_list.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  go_higher <- run_go_bp_one_direction(genes_higher, universe_genes, paste0("Higher ratio with ", contrast_title))

  go_lower <- run_go_bp_one_direction(genes_lower, universe_genes, paste0("Lower ratio with ", contrast_title))

  go_all <- bind_rows(go_higher, go_lower)

  if (is.null(go_all) || nrow(go_all) == 0) {
    message("No GO terms to plot for ", contrast_title, " — ", analysis_label)
    return(NULL)
  }

  write.csv(go_all, file.path(go_dir, paste0("GO_BP_AllTerms_", file_tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  go_plot <- go_all %>%
    group_by(Direction) %>%
    slice_min(p.adjust, n = go_top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Description_wrapped = str_wrap(Description, width = 45),
      Direction = factor(Direction, levels = unique(Direction))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Direction, FoldEnrich) %>%
    mutate(Description_wrapped = factor(Description_wrapped, levels = unique(Description_wrapped)))

  p <- ggplot(go_plot, aes(y = Description_wrapped, x = FoldEnrich, size = Count, colour = neg_log10_fdr)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 1, xend = FoldEnrich, y = Description_wrapped, yend = Description_wrapped),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      colour = "grey60"
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.95) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Direction, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "#FDAE61", high = "#D62728", name = expression(-log[10](GO~FDR))) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Protein count", range = c(4, 9)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      title = stringr::str_wrap(
        paste0("GO Biological Processes — ", analysis_name, ", ", contrast_title, ", ", analysis_label),
        width = 95
      ),
      subtitle = paste0("Top ", go_top_n, " terms per direction"),
      x = "Fold enrichment",
      y = NULL,
      caption = paste0(
        "Input proteins split by treatment-related change in log2(Insoluble/Soluble). ",
        "Dashed line: fold enrichment = 1."
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey50", size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  h <- max(5, nrow(go_plot) * 0.42 + 2.2)

  save_plot_png(p, file.path(go_dir, paste0("GO_BP_Lollipop_", file_tag)), width = 9.5, height = h, dpi = 300)

  p
}
```

# Treatment × Sex interaction plots

For proteins with significant Exercise × Sex or Rapamycin × Sex interactions under the selected raw-p/FDR criterion, treatment means ± SEM are plotted separately by sex. In individual plots, the protein name appears only in the title and the subtitle reports only the interaction raw p-value and FDR.

```{r interaction-plots, fig.keep="none"}
make_interaction_mean_sem <- function(res_int, treatment_name, file_tag, interaction_label) {
  int_dir <- file.path(interaction_dir, file_tag)

  safe_dir_create(int_dir)

  sig_int <- res_int %>%
    filter(
      Protein %in% rownames(ratio_mat),
      abs(logFC) >= interaction_lfc_cutoff,
      if (interaction_fdr_only) {
        SigFDR
      } else {
        SigAny
      }
    ) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val, P.Value)

  write.csv(sig_int, file.path(int_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_sig_int_proteins.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  if (nrow(sig_int) == 0) {
    message("No significant ", interaction_label, " proteins found using the selected criteria.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  keep_treatments <- c("Control", treatment_name)

  plot_long <- ratio_mat[sig_int$Protein, meta_use$ID, drop = FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Protein") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Protein, names_to = "ID", values_to = "log2_ratio") %>%
    left_join(meta_use %>% select(ID, Treatment, Sex, Group), by = "ID") %>%
    filter(Treatment %in% keep_treatments) %>%
    left_join(sig_int %>% select(Protein, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, SigClass), by = "Protein") %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = keep_treatments),
      Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
      Protein_label = paste0(Protein, "\nInt p=", format_p(P.Value), "; FDR=", format_p(adj.P.Val))
    )

  label_levels <- sig_int %>%
    mutate(Protein_label = paste0(Protein, "\nInt p=", format_p(P.Value), "; FDR=", format_p(adj.P.Val))) %>%
    pull(Protein_label)

  plot_long <- plot_long %>%
    mutate(Protein_label = factor(Protein_label, levels = label_levels))

  summary_df <- plot_long %>%
    group_by(Protein, Protein_label, Treatment, Sex, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, SigClass) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(log2_ratio)),
      mean_log2_ratio = mean(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log2_ratio = sd(log2_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      sem_log2_ratio =
        sd_log2_ratio / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sem_log2_ratio = ifelse(is.na(sem_log2_ratio), 0, sem_log2_ratio))

  write.csv(summary_df, file.path(int_dir, paste0(file_tag, "_mean_SEM_summary.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  n_prot <- length(unique(summary_df$Protein))

  ncol_int <- ifelse(n_prot <= 2, n_prot, 4)

  nrow_int <- ceiling(n_prot / ncol_int)

  plot_w <- max(8, ncol_int * 4.0)

  plot_h <- max(5.5, nrow_int * 3.4)

  subtitle <- if (interaction_fdr_only) {
    paste0("FDR <= ", fdr_cutoff, " | means ± SEM")
  } else {
    paste0("Raw p <= ", raw_p_cutoff, " or FDR <= ", fdr_cutoff, " | means ± SEM")
  }

  p_all <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_log2_ratio, color = Sex, group = Sex)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 3.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_log2_ratio - sem_log2_ratio, ymax = mean_log2_ratio + sem_log2_ratio),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~Protein_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_int) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control" = "Old Ctl", "Exercise" = "Old+Ex", "Rapamycin" = "Old+Rapa")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Significant ", interaction_label, " Proteins — Insoluble/Soluble Ratio"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean log2(Insoluble/Soluble)",
      color = "Sex"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", hjust = 0, size = 12),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  save_plot_png(
    p_all,
    file.path(int_dir, paste0("MeanSEM_", file_tag, "_All")),
    width = plot_w,
    height = plot_h,
    dpi = 300
  )

  for (prot in unique(sig_int$Protein)) {
    dat_p <- summary_df %>%
      filter(Protein == prot)

    lab_p <- paste0("Int p=", format_p(unique(dat_p$P.Value)[1]), "; FDR=", format_p(unique(dat_p$adj.P.Val)[1]))

    p_one <- ggplot(dat_p, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_log2_ratio, color = Sex, group = Sex)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(size = 3.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = mean_log2_ratio - sem_log2_ratio, ymax = mean_log2_ratio + sem_log2_ratio),
        width = 0.12,
        linewidth = 0.85,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Control" = "Old Ctl", "Exercise" = "Old+Ex", "Rapamycin" = "Old+Rapa")) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(analysis_name, " — ", prot),
        subtitle = lab_p,
        x = NULL,
        y = "Mean log2(Insoluble/Soluble)",
        color = "Sex"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right"
      )

    save_plot_png(
      p_one,
      file.path(int_dir, paste0("MeanSEM_", file_tag, "_", safe_filename(prot))),
      width = 6.2,
      height = 5.3,
      dpi = 300
    )
  }

  p_all
}
```

# Directional reversal of age-associated protein partitioning

This section integrates the Adult-vs-Old solubility analysis with the Old-treatment analysis. For proteins common to the corresponding analyses:

\[
x = \mathrm{Age\ effect}
= \log_2(\mathrm{Insoluble/Soluble})_{Old\ Control}
- \log_2(\mathrm{Insoluble/Soluble})_{Adult\ Control}
\]

\[
y = \mathrm{Treatment\ effect}
= \log_2(\mathrm{Insoluble/Soluble})_{Treatment}
- \log_2(\mathrm{Insoluble/Soluble})_{Old\ Control}
\]

Thus, `Age_logFC > 0` means aging shifted a protein toward greater relative insolubility, whereas `Trt_logFC < 0` means treatment shifted it toward greater relative solubility. The dotted `y = -x` line represents complete estimated offset of the age effect.

Two complementary analyses are generated:

1. **Pooled reversal:** sex-averaged age effect versus sex-averaged treatment effect.
2. **Sex-matched reversal:** Female age effect versus Female treatment effect, and Male age effect versus Male treatment effect.
3. **Combined-sex visualization:** the same sex-matched Female and Male effects are overlaid in one coordinate system, with Female shown as circles and Male as triangles.

The sex-matched analysis is especially important when the age effect itself differs between Female and Male mice.

## Reversal classification and plotting

```{r reversal-functions}
reversal_class_levels <- c(
  "Age-shift reversed by treatment",
  "Further shifts age-associated direction",
  "Age-associated shift unchanged",
  "Treatment effect without prior age shift",
  "Neither significant"
)

reversal_class_cols <- c(
  "Age-shift reversed by treatment" = "#009E73",
  "Further shifts age-associated direction" = "#D62728",
  "Age-associated shift unchanged" = "#3B3B8F",
  "Treatment effect without prior age shift" = "#B89C00",
  "Neither significant" = "grey80"
)

reversal_class_shapes <- c(
  "Age-shift reversed by treatment" = 16,
  "Further shifts age-associated direction" = 4,
  "Age-associated shift unchanged" = 16,
  "Treatment effect without prior age shift" = 16,
  "Neither significant" = 16
)

classify_reversal <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Age_sig_raw =
        !is.na(Age_P) &
        Age_P <= raw_p_cutoff,

      Age_sig_FDR =
        !is.na(Age_FDR) &
        Age_FDR <= fdr_cutoff,

      Trt_sig_raw =
        !is.na(Trt_P) &
        Trt_P <= raw_p_cutoff,

      Trt_sig_FDR =
        !is.na(Trt_FDR) &
        Trt_FDR <= fdr_cutoff,

      Opposite_direction =
        !is.na(Age_logFC) &
        !is.na(Trt_logFC) &
        Age_logFC * Trt_logFC < 0,

      Same_direction =
        !is.na(Age_logFC) &
        !is.na(Trt_logFC) &
        Age_logFC * Trt_logFC > 0,

      Net_vs_Adult =
        Age_logFC +
        Trt_logFC,

      Reversal_extent = case_when(
        Opposite_direction &
          !is.na(Age_logFC) &
          Age_logFC != 0 ~
          -Trt_logFC / Age_logFC,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      Reversal_magnitude = case_when(
        Opposite_direction &
          Reversal_extent < 1 ~
          "Partial reversal",
        Opposite_direction &
          Reversal_extent >= 1 ~
          "Complete/overshoot reversal",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      Reversal_direction = case_when(
        Opposite_direction &
          Age_logFC > 0 &
          Trt_logFC < 0 ~
          "Age increase in relative insolubility reversed toward solubility",
        Opposite_direction &
          Age_logFC < 0 &
          Trt_logFC > 0 ~
          "Age decrease in relative insolubility reversed toward insolubility",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      Class_FDR = case_when(
        Age_sig_FDR &
          Trt_sig_FDR &
          Opposite_direction ~
          "Age-shift reversed by treatment",

        Age_sig_FDR &
          Trt_sig_FDR &
          Same_direction ~
          "Further shifts age-associated direction",

        Age_sig_FDR &
          !Trt_sig_FDR ~
          "Age-associated shift unchanged",

        !Age_sig_FDR &
          Trt_sig_FDR ~
          "Treatment effect without prior age shift",

        TRUE ~
          "Neither significant"
      ),

      Class_raw = case_when(
        Age_sig_raw &
          Trt_sig_raw &
          Opposite_direction ~
          "Age-shift reversed by treatment",

        Age_sig_raw &
          Trt_sig_raw &
          Same_direction ~
          "Further shifts age-associated direction",

        Age_sig_raw &
          !Trt_sig_raw ~
          "Age-associated shift unchanged",

        !Age_sig_raw &
          Trt_sig_raw ~
          "Treatment effect without prior age shift",

        TRUE ~
          "Neither significant"
      )
    )
}

make_reversal_plot <- function(df, class_col, title, subtitle_prefix, lim_val = NULL) {

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(PlotClass = factor(.data[[class_col]], levels = reversal_class_levels))

  # Legend-only rows containing EVERY reversal category.
  #
  # These rows are invisible in the plotting panel. Their only purpose is
  # to guarantee that ggplot trains a legend key for all five categories,
  # even when one or more categories have zero observed proteins.
  reversal_legend_df <- tibble(
    PlotClass = factor(reversal_class_levels, levels = reversal_class_levels),
    legend_x = 0,
    legend_y = 0
  )

  if (class_col == "Class_FDR") {

    label_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(PlotClass == "Age-shift reversed by treatment") %>%
      mutate(rank_p = pmax(Age_FDR, Trt_FDR)) %>%
      arrange(rank_p) %>%
      slice_head(n = reversal_max_labels)

    significance_label <- "BH-FDR <= 0.05"

  } else {

    label_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(PlotClass == "Age-shift reversed by treatment") %>%
      mutate(rank_p = pmax(Age_P, Trt_P)) %>%
      arrange(rank_p) %>%
      slice_head(n = reversal_max_labels)

    significance_label <- "Raw p <= 0.05"
  }

  if (is.null(lim_val)) {

    lim_val <- max(abs(c(plot_df$Age_logFC, plot_df$Trt_logFC)), na.rm = TRUE)

    if (!is.finite(lim_val) || lim_val == 0) {
      lim_val <- 1
    }

    lim_val <- lim_val * 1.08
  }

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Age_logFC, y = Trt_logFC)) +
    geom_abline(slope = -1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.60) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.45) +
    # Actual observed proteins
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = PlotClass, shape = PlotClass),
      size = 2.7,
      alpha = 0.90,
      stroke = 1.05,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Invisible legend-training layer containing every reversal class.
    geom_point(
      data = reversal_legend_df,
      aes(x = legend_x, y = legend_y, colour = PlotClass, shape = PlotClass),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 2.7,
      alpha = 0,
      stroke = 1.05,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = Gene),
      size = 3.0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = reversal_class_cols,
      breaks = reversal_class_levels,
      limits = reversal_class_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = reversal_class_shapes,
      breaks = reversal_class_levels,
      limits = reversal_class_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = NULL
    ) +

    # Colour and shape use the same fixed levels and therefore merge into a
    # single legend. The dummy legend layer above guarantees that every key
    # is trained even if a category is absent from the observed data.
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = c(3.0, 3.4, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0), stroke = c(0.8, 1.2, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
      ),

      shape = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = c(3.0, 3.4, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0), stroke = c(0.8, 1.2, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
      )
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), ylim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = NULL, x = "Age effect, log2(Ins/Sol)", y = "Treatment effect, log2(Ins/Sol)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12.5) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 9.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.box.just = "left",
      legend.text = element_text(size = nm_style$legend_text)
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# Combined Female + Male reversal plot
#
# Female = circle
# Male   = triangle
#
# Reversal category = colour
# "Further shifts age-associated direction" = red X
#
# The main panel and legends are constructed separately so that Sex can use
# shape while the reversal-category legend preserves its own category-specific
# symbols. All five reversal categories are always shown in the legend.
# ==============================================================================

make_reversal_plot_combined_sex <- function(
  female_df,
  male_df,
  class_col,
  title_text,
  treatment_name,
  lim_val = NULL,
  max_labels = reversal_max_labels
) {

  plot_df <- bind_rows(female_df %>% mutate(Sex = "Female"), male_df %>% mutate(Sex = "Male")) %>%
    mutate(
      Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
      PlotClass = factor(.data[[class_col]], levels = reversal_class_levels)
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Label reversed proteins only
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (class_col == "Class_FDR") {

    label_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(PlotClass == "Age-shift reversed by treatment") %>%
      mutate(rank_p = pmax(Age_FDR, Trt_FDR)) %>%
      arrange(rank_p) %>%
      slice_head(n = max_labels)

  } else {

    label_df <- plot_df %>%
      filter(PlotClass == "Age-shift reversed by treatment") %>%
      mutate(rank_p = pmax(Age_P, Trt_P)) %>%
      arrange(rank_p) %>%
      slice_head(n = max_labels)
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Axis limits
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(lim_val)) {

    lim_val <- max(abs(c(plot_df$Age_logFC, plot_df$Trt_logFC)), na.rm = TRUE)

    if (!is.finite(lim_val) || lim_val == 0) {
      lim_val <- 1
    }

    lim_val <- lim_val * 1.08
  }

  regular_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(PlotClass != "Further shifts age-associated direction")

  further_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(PlotClass == "Further shifts age-associated direction")

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main combined-sex panel — no legends
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  p_main <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Age_logFC, y = Trt_logFC)) +

    geom_abline(slope = -1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.60) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.45) +

    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.45) +

    # Female = circle; Male = triangle.
    geom_point(
      data = regular_df,
      aes(colour = PlotClass, shape = Sex),
      size = 3.0,
      alpha = 0.88,
      stroke = 1.0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Preserve the red X in the data panel.
    geom_point(
      data = further_df,
      aes(colour = PlotClass),
      shape = 4,
      size = 3.5,
      alpha = 0.95,
      stroke = 1.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = Gene, colour = PlotClass),
      size = 3.0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.40,
      point.padding = 0.30,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.25,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = reversal_class_cols,
      breaks = reversal_class_levels,
      limits = reversal_class_levels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Female" = 16, "Male" = 17)) +

    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), ylim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), clip = "off") +

    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = NULL,
      x = "Age effect, log2(Ins/Sol)",
      y = "Treatment effect, log2(Ins/Sol)"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 10),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reversal-category legend
  #
  # Same category-only strategy used in the split-sex plots.
  # All five levels are supplied explicitly, including the red X.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  class_legend_df <- tibble(
    PlotClass = factor(reversal_class_levels, levels = reversal_class_levels),
    x = 1,
    y = seq_along(reversal_class_levels)
  )

  p_class_legend <- ggplot(class_legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = PlotClass, shape = PlotClass)) +

    geom_point(size = 3.2, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.1) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = reversal_class_cols,
      breaks = reversal_class_levels,
      limits = reversal_class_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Reversal category"
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = reversal_class_shapes,
      breaks = reversal_class_levels,
      limits = reversal_class_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Reversal category"
    ) +

    theme_void() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = nm_style$legend_text)
    )

  legend_class <- cowplot::get_legend(p_class_legend)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Sex legend
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  sex_legend_df <- tibble(Sex = factor(c("Female", "Male"), levels = c("Female", "Male")), x = 1, y = c(1, 2))

  p_sex_legend <- ggplot(sex_legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, shape = Sex)) +

    geom_point(colour = "black", size = 3.2, alpha = 1, stroke = 1.0) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Female" = 16, "Male" = 17),
      breaks = c("Female", "Male"),
      limits = c("Female", "Male"),
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Sex"
    ) +

    theme_void() +

    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = nm_style$legend_text)
    )

  legend_sex <- cowplot::get_legend(p_sex_legend)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Same compact upper-right legend configuration as the insoluble figure.
  #
  # 12% = Sex legend
  # 38% = Reversal category legend
  # 50% = empty space below
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  legend_column <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend_sex,
    legend_class,
    NULL,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    rel_heights = c(0.12, 0.38, 0.50)
  )

  attr(p_main, "nm_legend_grob") <- legend_column
  attr(p_main, "nm_legend_width_mm") <- 72
  attr(p_main, "nm_legend_height_mm") <- 34
  p_main
}
```
