## Viewer-friendly category tables

```{r reversal-summary-functions}
format_reversal_protein_list <- function(x, max_names = reversal_summary_max_names) {

  x <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]))

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (length(x) <= max_names) {
    return(paste(x, collapse = ", "))
  }

  paste0(
    paste(x[seq_len(max_names)], collapse = ", "),
    " … (+",
    length(x) - max_names,
    " more; see membership CSV)"
  )
}

make_reversal_membership <- function(dat, class_col, analysis_label, significance_label) {

  dat %>%
    transmute(
      Analysis = analysis_label,
      Significance = significance_label,
      Category = as.character(.data[[class_col]]),
      Protein.Group,
      Protein = coalesce(as.character(Gene), as.character(Protein.Group)),
      Age_logFC,
      Age_P,
      Age_FDR,
      Trt_logFC,
      Trt_P,
      Trt_FDR,
      Net_vs_Adult,
      Reversal_extent,
      Reversal_magnitude,
      Reversal_direction
    )
}

make_reversal_category_summary <- function(membership_df) {

  # Compact summary tables omit "Neither significant".
  # The full membership CSVs still retain every protein/category.
  summary_levels <- setdiff(reversal_class_levels, "Neither significant")

  membership_df %>%
    filter(Category != "Neither significant") %>%
    mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = summary_levels)) %>%
    group_by(Analysis, Significance, Category) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), Proteins = format_reversal_protein_list(Protein), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      Analysis,
      Significance,
      Category = factor(summary_levels, levels = summary_levels),
      fill = list(n = 0, Proteins = "—")
    ) %>%
    arrange(Analysis, Category)
}

show_reversal_category_table <- function(summary_df, caption_text) {

  summary_df %>%
    mutate(Category = as.character(Category)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Analysis, Category, n, Proteins) %>%
    knitr::kable(
      caption = caption_text,
      col.names = c("Analysis", "Reversal category", "n", "Proteins"),
      align = c("l", "l", "c", "l")
    )
}
```

## Load Adult-vs-Old ratio effects

```{r load-age-ratio-effects}
if (run_reversal_analysis) {

  ratio_age_overall_file <- find_result_file(
    ratio_age_results_root,
    c(
      "DE_Ratio_Age_Old_vs_Adult_VC.csv",
      "DE_Ratio_Age_Old_vs_Adult.csv",
      "DE_Ratio_InsSol_Age_results.csv",
      "DE_Ratio_Age_Old_vs_Adult_limma_2x2.csv",
      "DE_Age_Old_vs_Adult.csv",
      "DE_Age_Old_vs_Adult_limma_2x2.csv"
    )
  )

  ratio_age_sex_file <- find_result_file(
    ratio_age_results_root,
    c("Female_vs_Male_AgeEffects_Ratio_limma_VC.csv", "Female_vs_Male_AgeEffects_Ratio_limma.csv")
  )

  cat(
    "Overall Adult-vs-Old ratio table: ",
    ratio_age_overall_file,
    "\nSex-specific Adult-vs-Old ratio table: ",
    ratio_age_sex_file,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  ratio_age_overall_raw <- read.csv(ratio_age_overall_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  ratio_age_sex_raw <- read.csv(ratio_age_sex_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  required_overall <- c("Protein.Group", "logFC", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val")

  missing_overall <- setdiff(required_overall, names(ratio_age_overall_raw))

  if (length(missing_overall) > 0) {
    stop("Overall Adult-vs-Old ratio table is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_overall, collapse = ", "))
  }

  required_sex <- c("Protein.Group", "Female_logFC", "Female_P", "Female_FDR", "Male_logFC", "Male_P", "Male_FDR")

  missing_sex <- setdiff(required_sex, names(ratio_age_sex_raw))

  if (length(missing_sex) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Sex-specific Adult-vs-Old ratio table is missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_sex, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  overall_gene_col <- intersect(c("Gene_clean", "Gene", "Genes"), names(ratio_age_overall_raw))

  if (length(overall_gene_col) > 0) {

    overall_gene_col <- overall_gene_col[1]

    overall_gene <- if (overall_gene_col == "Genes") {
      first_gene_symbol(ratio_age_overall_raw[[overall_gene_col]])
    } else {
      as.character(ratio_age_overall_raw[[overall_gene_col]])
    }

  } else {

    overall_gene <- as.character(ratio_age_overall_raw$Protein.Group)
  }

  ratio_age_overall_tbl <- tibble(
    Protein.Group =
      as.character(ratio_age_overall_raw$Protein.Group),
    Gene =
      overall_gene,
    Age_logFC =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_overall_raw$logFC)),
    Age_P =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_overall_raw$P.Value)),
    Age_FDR =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_overall_raw$adj.P.Val))
  ) %>%
    arrange(Age_P) %>%
    distinct(Protein.Group, .keep_all = TRUE)

  sex_gene_col <- intersect(c("Gene", "Gene_clean", "Genes"), names(ratio_age_sex_raw))

  if (length(sex_gene_col) > 0) {

    sex_gene_col <- sex_gene_col[1]

    sex_gene <- if (sex_gene_col == "Genes") {
      first_gene_symbol(ratio_age_sex_raw[[sex_gene_col]])
    } else {
      as.character(ratio_age_sex_raw[[sex_gene_col]])
    }

  } else {

    sex_gene <- as.character(ratio_age_sex_raw$Protein.Group)
  }

  ratio_age_sex_tbl <- tibble(
    Protein.Group =
      as.character(ratio_age_sex_raw$Protein.Group),
    Gene =
      sex_gene,
    Female_Age_logFC =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Female_logFC)),
    Female_Age_P =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Female_P)),
    Female_Age_FDR =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Female_FDR)),
    Male_Age_logFC =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Male_logFC)),
    Male_Age_P =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Male_P)),
    Male_Age_FDR =
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ratio_age_sex_raw$Male_FDR))
  ) %>%
    distinct(Protein.Group, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

## Build pooled and sex-matched reversal tables

```{r build-ratio-reversal-tables}
if (run_reversal_analysis) {

  prepare_ratio_treatment_effect <- function(res) {

    res %>%
      transmute(
        Protein.Group =
          as.character(Protein.Group),
        Trt_Gene =
          as.character(Gene_clean),
        Trt_logFC =
          as.numeric(logFC),
        Trt_P =
          as.numeric(P.Value),
        Trt_FDR =
          as.numeric(adj.P.Val)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Trt_P) %>%
      distinct(Protein.Group, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  make_pooled_ratio_reversal <- function(treatment_res, treatment_name) {

    ratio_age_overall_tbl %>%
      inner_join(prepare_ratio_treatment_effect(treatment_res), by = "Protein.Group") %>%
      mutate(Gene = coalesce(Gene, Trt_Gene, Protein.Group), Treatment = treatment_name) %>%
      classify_reversal()
  }

  make_sex_ratio_reversal <- function(treatment_res, sex_name, treatment_name) {

    trt_tbl <- prepare_ratio_treatment_effect(treatment_res)

    if (sex_name == "Female") {

      age_tbl <- ratio_age_sex_tbl %>%
        transmute(
          Protein.Group,
          Gene,
          Age_logFC = Female_Age_logFC,
          Age_P = Female_Age_P,
          Age_FDR = Female_Age_FDR
        )

    } else {

      age_tbl <- ratio_age_sex_tbl %>%
        transmute(Protein.Group, Gene, Age_logFC = Male_Age_logFC, Age_P = Male_Age_P, Age_FDR = Male_Age_FDR)
    }

    age_tbl %>%
      inner_join(trt_tbl, by = "Protein.Group") %>%
      mutate(Gene = coalesce(Gene, Trt_Gene, Protein.Group), Sex = sex_name, Treatment = treatment_name) %>%
      classify_reversal()
  }

  ratio_reversal_ex_pooled <- make_pooled_ratio_reversal(res_ex_ctl, "Exercise")

  ratio_reversal_ex_female <- make_sex_ratio_reversal(res_ex_female, "Female", "Exercise")

  ratio_reversal_ex_male <- make_sex_ratio_reversal(res_ex_male, "Male", "Exercise")

  ratio_reversal_rapa_pooled <- make_pooled_ratio_reversal(res_rapa_ctl, "Rapamycin")

  ratio_reversal_rapa_female <- make_sex_ratio_reversal(res_rapa_female, "Female", "Rapamycin")

  ratio_reversal_rapa_male <- make_sex_ratio_reversal(res_rapa_male, "Male", "Rapamycin")

  ratio_reversal_tables <- list(
    Exercise_Pooled = ratio_reversal_ex_pooled,
    Exercise_Female = ratio_reversal_ex_female,
    Exercise_Male = ratio_reversal_ex_male,
    Rapamycin_Pooled = ratio_reversal_rapa_pooled,
    Rapamycin_Female = ratio_reversal_rapa_female,
    Rapamycin_Male = ratio_reversal_rapa_male
  )

  purrr::iwalk(
    ratio_reversal_tables,
    function(dat, nm) {

      write.csv(dat, file.path(reversal_dir, paste0(nm, "_AllCommon.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

      write.csv(
        dat %>%
          filter(Class_FDR == "Age-shift reversed by treatment"),
        file.path(reversal_dir, paste0(nm, "_Reversed_FDR.csv")),
        row.names = FALSE
      )

      write.csv(
        dat %>%
          filter(Class_raw == "Age-shift reversed by treatment"),
        file.path(reversal_dir, paste0(nm, "_Reversed_RawP.csv")),
        row.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  exercise_membership_fdr <- bind_rows(
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_pooled, "Class_FDR", "Pooled", "FDR"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_female, "Class_FDR", "Female", "FDR"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_male, "Class_FDR", "Male", "FDR")
  )

  rapamycin_membership_fdr <- bind_rows(
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_pooled, "Class_FDR", "Pooled", "FDR"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_female, "Class_FDR", "Female", "FDR"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_male, "Class_FDR", "Male", "FDR")
  )

  exercise_membership_raw <- bind_rows(
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_pooled, "Class_raw", "Pooled", "Raw p"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_female, "Class_raw", "Female", "Raw p"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_ex_male, "Class_raw", "Male", "Raw p")
  )

  rapamycin_membership_raw <- bind_rows(
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_pooled, "Class_raw", "Pooled", "Raw p"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_female, "Class_raw", "Female", "Raw p"),
    make_reversal_membership(ratio_reversal_rapa_male, "Class_raw", "Male", "Raw p")
  )

  exercise_summary_fdr <- make_reversal_category_summary(exercise_membership_fdr)

  rapamycin_summary_fdr <- make_reversal_category_summary(rapamycin_membership_fdr)

  exercise_summary_raw <- make_reversal_category_summary(exercise_membership_raw)

  rapamycin_summary_raw <- make_reversal_category_summary(rapamycin_membership_raw)

  write.csv(
    exercise_membership_fdr,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Exercise_Ratio_Reversal_CategoryMembership_FDR.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    rapamycin_membership_fdr,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Rapamycin_Ratio_Reversal_CategoryMembership_FDR.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    exercise_membership_raw,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Exercise_Ratio_Reversal_CategoryMembership_RawP.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    rapamycin_membership_raw,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Rapamycin_Ratio_Reversal_CategoryMembership_RawP.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    exercise_summary_fdr,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Exercise_Ratio_Reversal_CategorySummary_FDR.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    rapamycin_summary_fdr,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Rapamycin_Ratio_Reversal_CategorySummary_FDR.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    exercise_summary_raw,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Exercise_Ratio_Reversal_CategorySummary_RawP.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    rapamycin_summary_raw,
    file.path(reversal_dir, "Rapamycin_Ratio_Reversal_CategorySummary_RawP.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Interpretation guide

The reversal categories are:

- **Age-shift reversed by treatment — green circle:** age and treatment are significant under the selected criterion and point in opposite directions.
- **Further shifts age-associated direction — red X:** age and treatment are significant and point in the same direction.
- **Age-associated shift unchanged — blue circle:** the age effect is significant but the treatment effect is not.
- **Treatment effect without prior age shift — mustard circle:** treatment is significant but the corresponding age effect is not.
- **Neither significant — grey circle:** neither effect is significant under the selected criterion.

For `log2(Insoluble/Soluble)`, the most direct rescue pattern is `Age_logFC > 0` together with `Trt_logFC < 0`, because aging shifted the protein toward greater relative insolubility and treatment shifted it back toward greater relative solubility.

`Net_vs_Adult = Age_logFC + Trt_logFC` is exported as a descriptive estimate of the treated-old position relative to Adult. Values near zero indicate approximate restoration of the Adult effect estimate, but this is not itself a formal test.

# Female vs Male treatment effects (manuscript panels)

This section creates compact manuscript panels that compare the treatment effect in
Female versus Male old mice. The analysis itself is unchanged; this is a new
visualization/export layer using the same Nature Metabolism and Inkscape-safe SVG
helpers used for the revised aggregation-propensity analyses.

Symbol convention:

- open circle = NS
- filled circle = overall treatment raw p <= 0.05
- filled diamond = Treatment x Sex raw p <= 0.05 (takes precedence if both are <= 0.05)

```{r fig5-nm-packages}

library(svglite)
library(viridisLite)
library(GO.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
```

```{r fig5-nm-component-helpers}
# ── Cellular-component assignment, matching revised Figure 4 ─────────────────
fig5_bin_roots <- list(
  "Sarcomere/Myofibril" = c("GO:0030017", "GO:0030016", "GO:0043292"),
  "Cytoskeleton"        = "GO:0005856",
  "Extracellular"       = "GO:0005576",
  "ECM"                 = "GO:0031012",
  "Nucleus"             = "GO:0005634",
  "Mitochondrion"       = "GO:0005739",
  "Plasma membrane"     = "GO:0005886",
  "Cytosol"             = "GO:0005829"
)

fig5_bin_order <- names(fig5_bin_roots)
fig5_go_cc_offspring <- AnnotationDbi::as.list(GO.db::GOCCOFFSPRING)

fig5_get_offspring <- function(go_id) {
  unique(c(go_id, fig5_go_cc_offspring[[go_id]]))
}

fig5_bin_terms <- lapply(
  fig5_bin_roots,
  function(ids) unique(unlist(lapply(ids, fig5_get_offspring), use.names = FALSE))
)

fig5_assign_bin <- function(go_vec) {
  go_vec <- unique(go_vec[!is.na(go_vec)])
  if (length(go_vec) == 0) return("Other/Unassigned")
  for (b in fig5_bin_order) {
    if (any(go_vec %in% fig5_bin_terms[[b]])) return(b)
  }
  "Other/Unassigned"
}

fig5_build_gene_bin <- function(annotation_tbl, gene_col = "Gene_clean") {
  genes <- tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = as.character(annotation_tbl[[gene_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  gene2entrez <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = genes$SYMBOL,
      keytype = "SYMBOL",
      columns = c("SYMBOL", "ENTREZID")
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))

  entrez2go <- suppressMessages(
    AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
      keys = sort(unique(gene2entrez$ENTREZID)),
      keytype = "ENTREZID",
      columns = c("ENTREZID", "GO", "ONTOLOGY")
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ONTOLOGY == "CC", !is.na(GO)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(ENTREZID, GO)

  gene2entrez %>%
    dplyr::left_join(entrez2go, by = "ENTREZID") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(GO_CC = list(unique(GO)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Bin = vapply(GO_CC, fig5_assign_bin, character(1)))
}

# Reproduce the Figure 4 component-color logic: viridis colors assigned to the
# alphabetically sorted component set, then displayed in biological order.
fig5_palette_names <- sort(fig5_bin_order)
fig5_component_pal <- c(
  stats::setNames(viridisLite::viridis(length(fig5_palette_names), option = "D", end = 0.95), fig5_palette_names),
  "Other/Unassigned" = "grey60"
)
```

```{r fig5-nm-sex-effect-helpers}
fig5_max_labels <- 10

fig5_make_sex_effect_table <- function(
  overall_res,
  female_res,
  male_res,
  interaction_res,
  treatment_name,
  gene_bin_tbl
) {

  overall <- overall_res %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Protein, Overall_logFC = logFC, Overall_P = P.Value, Overall_FDR = adj.P.Val)

  female <- female_res %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Protein,
      Protein.Group,
      Gene_clean,
      Female_logFC = logFC,
      Female_P = P.Value,
      Female_FDR = adj.P.Val
    )

  male <- male_res %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Protein, Male_logFC = logFC, Male_P = P.Value, Male_FDR = adj.P.Val)

  interaction <- interaction_res %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Protein, Interaction_logFC = logFC, Interaction_P = P.Value, Interaction_FDR = adj.P.Val)

  female %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(male, by = "Protein") %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(overall, by = "Protein") %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(interaction, by = "Protein") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene_bin_tbl %>% dplyr::select(SYMBOL, Bin), by = c("Gene_clean" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Treatment = treatment_name,
      Bin = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Bin), "Other/Unassigned", Bin),
      OverallSig = !is.na(Overall_P) & Overall_P <= raw_p_cutoff,
      InteractionSig = !is.na(Interaction_P) & Interaction_P <= raw_p_cutoff,
      # User-requested precedence: any nominal Treatment x Sex interaction is
      # shown as a diamond; otherwise pooled treatment p<=0.05 is a filled circle.
      SigClass = dplyr::case_when(
        InteractionSig ~ "Treatment x Sex p <= 0.05",
        OverallSig ~ "Overall treatment p <= 0.05",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      Distance_from_identity = abs(Male_logFC - Female_logFC),
      Mean_abs_effect = (abs(Female_logFC) + abs(Male_logFC)) / 2
    )
}

fig5_make_sex_effect_plot <- function(dat, title_text, x_label, y_label, show_legend = TRUE) {

  plot_df <- dat %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(Female_logFC), is.finite(Male_logFC)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = c(fig5_bin_order, "Other/Unassigned")),
      SigClass = factor(SigClass, levels = c("Treatment x Sex p <= 0.05", "Overall treatment p <= 0.05", "NS"))
    )

  # Label interaction proteins first, then the strongest pooled treatment hits.
  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(SigClass != "NS") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_priority = dplyr::if_else(InteractionSig, 1L, 2L),
      label_p = dplyr::if_else(InteractionSig, Interaction_P, Overall_P)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(label_priority, label_p, dplyr::desc(Distance_from_identity), dplyr::desc(Mean_abs_effect)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = fig5_max_labels)

  lim_val <- max(abs(c(plot_df$Female_logFC, plot_df$Male_logFC)), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(lim_val) || lim_val == 0) lim_val <- 1
  lim_val <- lim_val * 1.08

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Female_logFC, y = Male_logFC)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dotted",
      colour = "grey35",
      linewidth = nm_style$data_line
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey72", linewidth = nm_style$axis_line) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey72", linewidth = nm_style$axis_line) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(colour = Bin, shape = SigClass),
      size = nm_style$point_medium,
      stroke = 0.40,
      alpha = 0.92
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      ggplot2::aes(label = Gene_clean, colour = Bin),
      size = nm_style$small_text / 2.845276,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.22,
      point.padding = 0.12,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.18,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = fig5_component_pal,
      breaks = c(fig5_bin_order, "Other/Unassigned"),
      drop = TRUE,
      name = "Cellular component"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Treatment x Sex p <= 0.05" = 18, "Overall treatment p <= 0.05" = 16, "NS" = 1),
      breaks = c("Treatment x Sex p <= 0.05", "Overall treatment p <= 0.05", "NS"),
      name = "Significance"
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        override.aes = list(colour = "black", alpha = 1, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.45)
      ),
      colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(shape = 16, alpha = 1, size = 1.8))
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), ylim = c(-lim_val, lim_val), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title_text, x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    theme_nm(legend_position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none", plot_title = TRUE, plot_subtitle = FALSE)

  p
}
```

```{r fig5-nm-run-ratio, fig.keep="none"}
fig5_nm_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "NM_SexFx")
dir.create(fig5_nm_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gene_bin_fig5 <- fig5_build_gene_bin(row_key, gene_col = "Gene_clean")

ex_sexfx_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_table(
  overall_res = res_ex_ctl,
  female_res = res_ex_female,
  male_res = res_ex_male,
  interaction_res = res_ex_int,
  treatment_name = "Exercise",
  gene_bin_tbl = gene_bin_fig5
)

rapa_sexfx_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_table(
  overall_res = res_rapa_ctl,
  female_res = res_rapa_female,
  male_res = res_rapa_male,
  interaction_res = res_rapa_int,
  treatment_name = "Rapamycin",
  gene_bin_tbl = gene_bin_fig5
)

write.csv(ex_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Ex_SexFx.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(rapa_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Rapa_SexFx.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_ex_sexfx_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_plot(
  ex_sexfx_nm,
  title_text = "Exercise: Ins/Sol partitioning",
  x_label = "Female effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  y_label = "Male effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  show_legend = FALSE
)

p_rapa_sexfx_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_plot(
  rapa_sexfx_nm,
  title_text = "Rapamycin: Ins/Sol partitioning",
  x_label = "Female effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  y_label = "Male effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  show_legend = FALSE
)

# Standalone panels: no legend, matching the compact footprint of current Fig. 5
# volcano panels. The combined pair below carries the shared legend.
save_nm_svg(p_ex_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Ex_Ratio_SexFx.svg"), size_key = "family_sex_single")
save_nm_png(p_ex_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Ex_Ratio_SexFx.png"), size_key = "family_sex_single")

save_nm_svg(p_rapa_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Rapa_Ratio_SexFx.svg"), size_key = "family_sex_single")
save_nm_png(p_rapa_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Rapa_Ratio_SexFx.png"), size_key = "family_sex_single")

# Rebuild only for the pair so the legends can be collected once.
p_ex_sexfx_legend_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_plot(
  ex_sexfx_nm,
  title_text = "Exercise: Ins/Sol partitioning",
  x_label = "Female effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  y_label = "Male effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_rapa_sexfx_legend_nm <- fig5_make_sex_effect_plot(
  rapa_sexfx_nm,
  title_text = "Rapamycin: Ins/Sol partitioning",
  x_label = "Female effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  y_label = "Male effect on log2(Ins/Sol)",
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_pair_sexfx_nm <- (
  p_ex_sexfx_legend_nm + p_rapa_sexfx_legend_nm +
    patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")
) &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

# Store one shared legend separately so the two treatment panels retain their
# full plotting area when imported into Inkscape.
attr(p_pair_sexfx_nm, "nm_legend_grob") <- nm_extract_legend(p_ex_sexfx_legend_nm)
attr(p_pair_sexfx_nm, "nm_legend_width_mm") <- 58
attr(p_pair_sexfx_nm, "nm_legend_height_mm") <- 58

save_nm_svg(p_pair_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Ratio_SexFx_pair.svg"), size_key = "family_sex_pair")
save_nm_png(p_pair_sexfx_nm, file.path(fig5_nm_dir, "Ratio_SexFx_pair.png"), size_key = "family_sex_pair")
```
